summary: Official Burhanpur district, Madhya Pradesh WebGIS/Bhu-Naksha, and Government of India DILRMP sources establish a cadastral/map custodian and public map procedure. The live viewer/GIS hosts timed out or exposed only a JavaScript shell during bounded anonymous requests, so no current parcel schema, CRS, safe native identity, or polygon was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries and actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-9095-burhanpur.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS verification remained enabled. Official district GIS loaded; WebGIS 2.0 shell showed JavaScript/security-notice content; direct requests to burhanpurgis.mp.gov.in and mpbhulekh.gov.in timed out. DILRMP indexed first-party content supplied district/tehsil digitization statistics but no parcel feature row. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup, or TLS exception was used.
